item.title: Asus posts record July revenue on strong AI server demand
item.summary: Asustek Computer (Asus) reported July 2026 group revenue of NT$84.13 billion (approx. US$2.61 billion), a record high for the period, up 53.3% from a year earlier but down 21% from the previous month. Growth was driven by strong demand for artificial intelligence (AI) servers. Group consolidated revenue for the first seven months of 2026 totaled NT$550.23 billion, up 40.9% year-over-year.
